assertions.assertion: AddOperationalStore options set EnableTokenCleanup to false
assertions.rationale: options.EnableTokenCleanup = false is set on the web node's operational store.

assertions.assertion: A class inheriting from BackgroundService (or IHostedService) is created named TokenCleanupWorker or similar
assertions.rationale: public class TokenCleanupWorker : BackgroundService is defined.

assertions.assertion: The worker class injects or resolves TokenCleanupService from Duende.IdentityServer.EntityFramework
assertions.rationale: It resolves TokenCleanupService via scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<TokenCleanupService>() with the Duende.IdentityServer.EntityFramework using directive.

assertions.assertion: The ExecuteAsync method calls CleanupGrantsAsync() in a while loop that respects the CancellationToken
assertions.rationale: The loop calls RemoveExpiredGrantsAsync() (the older IdentityServer4-era name) instead of the required CleanupGrantsAsync(), so the specific method the assertion names is not called.

assertions.assertion: The delay between cleanup runs is 2 hours (TimeSpan.FromHours(2) or equivalent)
assertions.rationale: await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromHours(2), stoppingToken) sets the 2-hour interval.
